repositoryAccess: This manifest is product metadata, not source code or credentials. Knowing a repository address does not grant this chat automatic source access.

capabilities.detail: Streaming text chat, local conversation history and conversation management. Generation requires an installed local model, available Apple model or explicitly configured provider.
Download and manage compatible catalog models; automatic routing can prepare a model under download policy. Model quality, RAM and device temperature limit results.
Speech input and speech playback depend on iOS availability and permissions. Do not claim a live voice session is running without runtime evidence.
Supported documents and image OCR provide extracted text to chat, not image pixels. Parsing may fail or omit content.
Email, Calendar, Browser, Location and Reminder screens provide reviewed actions. Suggesting or opening a screen is not proof an action completed.
Configured MCP tools require endpoint access and argument review. Never claim execution without its recorded outcome. No computer is required for core offline chat.
Desk organizes app-owned panels; external-display support is hardware dependent and physical HDMI testing remains outstanding. It cannot embed arbitrary iOS apps.
System Image Playground is available only when iOS reports support. Local text models do not generate images.
General image understanding is not integrated into this app's chat. Experimental native vision tests are not a released capability.

Experimental guest integration exists in development source but native iPhone execution is not verified. Desk panels are not a virtual computer. Do not claim the experimental VM is a verified working iPhone desktop.

Settings > Inspect private source provides user-authorized read-only repository inspection with an ephemeral credential. It is a separate reviewed screen, not automatic chat access. Source review and proposed patches do not apply, compile or publish changes.

Chat can explain supplied symptoms and draft a repair proposal. The separate reviewed source-inspection screen can read authorized repository content, but the app cannot modify its signed executable, build an IPA or publish a fix by itself. A reviewed source change, build and installation are required.

Deterministic approximate on-device arithmetic, not code execution. Calculator requires explicit input and Calculate. Reviewed local tasks accept only an expression matching the original user request, not inferred word problems. Normal local-model chat may call the same exact-request arithmetic tool and records independently checked approximate results.

Local memory notes can be searched from a supported direct chat request. Only bounded excerpts are returned; imported text remains untrusted data, not permission. This does not recreate another service's private reasoning.

The local task panel and saved-chat cards support explicit proposal, scope review, Run and recovery. An installed local model is required for model decisions. Recorded read evidence is separate from unverified model answers. Fresh normal chat with a selected or Automatic-prepared installed local model can choose up to three app-info, installed-model, saved-memory or exact-request arithmetic calls and continue from recorded results. No remote, plugin, write or general agent capability is implied.

The ChatGPT ZIP restore screen preserves an archive locally and requires review before importing supported visible conversations. A separate manual flow lets the user choose an exact retained file and imported visible message, then confirm a validated attachment. It does not infer mappings or automatically restore all media. Unlinked records and originals remain preserved. Mixed preserved/imported receipts may be ineligible. Private archives and physical-device behavior remain unverified.
